description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git send-pack' command, specifically testing its --stdin option and related behaviors. It sets up repositories, creates references, and verifies push operations through a series of test cases.

methods.name: create_ref
methods.description: Creates a new git reference with a specified name and commit message.

methods.name: clear_remote
methods.description: Removes an existing remote repository and reinitializes it as a bare repository.

methods.name: verify_push
methods.description: Verifies that a specific ref on the remote matches the expected revision.
